serving_compact.notes: Format: #SERVINFO: EARFCN,RSSI,"operator","MCCMNC",cell_id,TAC,PCI,?,RSRP. Less detail than RFSTS but includes PCI.

plmn_scan.notes: 3GPP operator scan. 30-120 seconds. Works without SIM.

diag.port: Qualcomm DM/DIAG on USB interface if00 (class ff/ff/ff), composition 1040 (also 1041 on some units). NOTE: the ttyUSB *number* floats across units/bus enumeration (observed as ttyUSB0/ttyUSB4/ttyUSB6), and the AT port is on if04 (NOT the lowest interface) — so interface-number matching, not lowest-ttyUSB or a fixed device node, is required. diagport=<path> overrides.
diag.notes: SDX20 LTE Cat 18 (no NR radio). Subscribes the LTE subset of DIAG_TARGET_CODES (capture_cell_diag/diag_config.c is the single source of truth): LTE ML1 serving 0xB193, LTE RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB0C0, LTE ML1 idle neighbors 0xB192, LTE ML1 connected neighbors 0xB195, LTE ML1 per-cell measurement 0xB17F (per-cell RSSI with RSRP/RSRQ); the NR5G codes (0xB821/0xB97F) never fire. Telit's USB layout puts DIAG on if00 but AT on if04. A 'lowest ttyUSB' default would wrongly select if00's sibling if the in-modem kernel diag driver (DIAG_USB_diag) has claimed if00 (routing DIAG via /dev/diag), which happens on some units; interface=0 then correctly finds no if00 ttyUSB and surfaces the actionable diagnostic rather than opening the AT port as DIAG. If DIAG is only reachable via the modem's /dev/diag kernel node, pass diagport= explicitly. GNSS position 0x1476 (LTE ML1 / gpsOne position report) and 0x14D8 (GNSS engine state) complete the set: the capture helper turns 0x1476 into a gps_fix and geo-tags every cell_observation from it. 0x14D8 is subscribed but yields no position (its parser hardcodes lat/lon/alt to 0.0 and no firmware populates those bytes), so it contributes engine state only. This list documents intent; the device decides what is actually subscribed, because diag_config_filter_supported narrows the shared set to each modem's advertised subset at handshake time. 0xB17F is emitted with version byte 5, including on a SIM-less unit. LTE ML1 serving cell information 0xB197 (per-cell DL bandwidth RB + Tx antenna ports) is emitted with version byte 2 after an AT+CFUN=4->1 re-camp, even without a SIM, and not during an idle window before it. It is event-driven (camp/config), so an idle window reading 0 is not absence; a CFUN cycle is enough to trigger it, no power cycle needed.

quirks.ati_returns_build_number: ATI returns '332' (build number), not model name. Use AT+CGMM for model.
quirks.band_255_means_unavailable: AT#RFSTS band field reports 255 when not available. Filter to 0.
quirks.bnd_query_slow: AT#BND? takes ~30 seconds to respond. Use 45s+ timeout.
quirks.csurv_broken_on_some_profiles: AT#CSURV returns empty on Generic (32.01.110) and TMUS (32.01.150) firmware profiles.
